location.description: KVM location URI: kvm://[<host>]/[system|session]. Examples: kvm:///system, kvm://node1/system

connect_uri.description: Explicit libvirt connection URI passed to virsh -c (overrides the URI derived from location). Example: qemu+ssh://root@node1/system

domains.description: Comma-separated list of domain (VM) names to back up. Empty means all defined domains.

consistency.description: Consistency strategy: 'crash' reads live images (crash-consistent), 'fsfreeze' quiesces the guest via qemu-guest-agent around the read (application-consistent when the agent is installed), 'snapshot' uses an atomic external disk-only snapshot.

include_disks.description: Whether to include the VM disk images in the backup (in addition to the libvirt domain XML definition).
